messages:
Jamal H: trying to push v1.4.2 into prod during the change window but deploy-bot rejected me, who is the prod signer this week? need to finish canary :grimacing:
DeployBot: [AUTOMATED] deploy blocked for user jamal.h — authorization failed: missing role 'prod-deployer' :lock:
Alex P: I rotated off yesterday, Priya S is the signer today — @Priya S can you confirm? :wave:
Priya S: i'm on until 17:00 UTC, can sign. Jamal, did you request JIT already?
Jamal H: I opened a JIT yesterday but still getting denied when I click Deploy -> "Authorize" shows "Invalid MFA device"
Alex P: are you triggering from the web console or the cli? if console, sometimes cached cookies + bad MFA state cause weird errors
Jamal H: console. tried incognito, still same error.
Priya S: try the ephemeral SSO link instead: https://id.redwood/team/sso/jit?user=jamal.h
Jamal H: clicking it now... auth went through but deploy-bot still says "authorization denied"
DeployBot: [LOG] 2168765437 — approval record found for jamal.h, approver=Priya S, but check failed: source_ip=10.54.1.23 not in allowed_cidrs
Oncall SRE: aha — prod deploys require corp VPN IP range. Are you on corp vpn?
Jamal H: oof i'm remote and not on VPN, coffee shop wifi atm.
Alex P: that's the missing piece then :eyes: prod-deployer role + MFA + on-corp-vpn are all enforced by the gate. we can't relax IP checks during the change window.
Priya S: if it's urgent, option A: I can do the sign + run the push from a corp host. option B: fallback -> rollback canary to 1.4.1 to stop bad behavior while we sort access.
Maria G: i can SSH from office and trigger the rollout if Priya approves and we add audit note.
Jamal H: prefer to push hotfix (1.4.3) rather than rollback. what's the process to get temporary exception?
Alex P: exceptions need exec approval + security slack thread + an access ticket. not ideal for a small hotfix.
Priya S: agreed. easiest is: Jamal package the hotfix branch, push the tag to staging, i'll pull+deploy from corp laptop and document steps. Jamal, post the tag and a short deploy plan here.
Jamal H: pushing tag now: `git tag -a v1.4.3-hotfix -m "fix: kv-cache overflow" && git push origin v1.4.3-hotfix`
DeployBot: [AUTOMATED] created release record for v1.4.3-hotfix, release_id=rel_2023_216876
Maria G: i've made myself available, ping when ready and i'll run the deploy from office.
Priya S: i'll approve when i see the plan. make sure to include rollback steps and expected failure modes.
Jamal H: plan pasted: 1) tag push (done) 2) smoke canary to 10% for 15m 3) monitor errors + latency dashboards 4) promote to 100% if green 5) rollback command: `infractl release rollback --id rel_2023_216876 --to-tag v1.4.1`
Maria G: 👍 executing step 2 from office now. will report back in 10m.
Oncall SRE: note — please file an after-action ticket to trace why JIT + SSO didn't provide corp IP binding; could be NAT/policy or SSO backend not populating claim.
Jamal H: will file a ticket after this. thanks all for the quick help :thankyou: :thumbsup:
Priya S: signed and observed deploy. everything green at canary, promoting to 100% now. :rocket:
DeployBot: [AUTOMATED] release rel_2023_216876 promoted to 100% — completed at 2168765498
Jamal H: release confirmed. i've opened infra ticket INF-4921 for the MFA/JIT/ip failure and added the deploy audit log.
Alex P: great. follow-up actions: (1) add a small doc to eng-runbook about corp-vpn requirement on prod pushes, (2) verify SSO claims population. assigning to Oncall SRE.
Oncall SRE: taking INF-4921. will triage tomorrow and report in eng-releases.
Maria G: nice work team.
Jamal H: thanks everyone, especially Priya + Maria for the assist.
